title: Small data-plane API change needs review

question: We have a spec PR and a small additive change. How do we request Board review and signoff without booking a meeting?
ground_truth: Use the current data-plane REST API review process: email azureapirbcore@microsoft.com with the spec PR, design and hero scenarios, prior review, and change summary at least two days before signoff is needed. Explain minor-change eligibility rather than assuming every change qualifies; the Board can arrange synchronous sessions for larger changes. data-plane-review-requested queues review, while data-plane-review-signoff is protected authorized signoff. Offer advisory guidance only; do not approve, apply labels, or tell the user to repost in this same General channel.
source: Anonymized export thread 1774850126722 (2026-03-30); stewardship-knowledge-materials.md D01, current-process summary
